name: Rafters Restaurant
description_short: Relaxed riverside dining in Storms River village with hearty pub-style fare and local atmosphere.
description_long:
Tucked away in the heart of Storms River village, Rafters Restaurant offers a laid-back stop for travellers exploring the Tsitsikamma region. The menu focuses on honest pub-style classics—think burgers, grills, and seafood platters—served in generous portions that hit the spot after a day of adventure activities or forest hikes.

The setting is casual and unpretentious, with a friendly local vibe that makes it easy to settle in for a long lunch or relaxed dinner. It's the kind of place where you can shake off the trail dust, enjoy a cold drink, and fuel up before tackling the next stretch of the Garden Route. While it won't win awards for haute cuisine, Rafters delivers solid, satisfying fare in a convenient village location that serves both locals and visitors passing through this spectacular corner of the Eastern Cape.
